prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one production-ready solid line-art companion icon for a game relic

Primary request:
Draw exactly one compact, solid white and pale-ice-blue line-art emblem of the Solitary Crown. This is a dedicated outline-state asset, not a colored jewel painting and not a lighting effect. It depicts one empty, unoccupied, aristocratic magical-girl crown as a closed physical emblem.

Object geometry:
Use a nearly front-facing orthographic view. Make one strong, symmetrical, connected five-peak crown: one tallest central tapered peak, two medium inner peaks, two shorter outer peaks, a clearly closed lower circlet, one central diamond-shaped crystal setting, and one small butterfly ornament physically attached above the crystal. Use a solid near-opaque white crown body, a clean pale-ice-blue outer line, and a few broad pale-ice-blue internal line-art divisions for the crystal setting, circlet, and butterfly wings. The white and pale-blue marks form one hard-edged closed crown emblem. They are solid ink-like shapes, not light.

Composition:
Center the crown exactly. The complete crown occupies approximately 60 percent of the canvas width and 55 percent of the canvas height. Keep every crown tip, butterfly wing, white shape, pale-blue line, contour pixel, and antialiasing pixel inside that central area. Leave a very wide completely empty safety area on all four sides. The outermost 20 percent of the canvas on the top, bottom, left, and right contains absolutely no visual mark of any kind. Nothing may touch or approach an edge.

Rendering:
Crisp production game UI line art with bold solid white shapes, pale ice-blue contour ink, sparse broad internal divisions, and only normal tight edge antialiasing. No realistic metal, gem, or full-color rendering. Every white and pale-blue mark ends completely at the crown's physical outer contour. The result must remain clearly crown-shaped at 256 by 256 pixels and must not resemble a blue light cloud.

Hard exclusions:
Outside the crown body there is absolutely no halo, aura, bloom, glow, mist, haze, fog, smoke, shadow, cast shadow, ambient light, light spill, rays, particles, sparks, dust, cloud, soft field, detached color, detached pixel, or feathered edge. No blue or gray light cloud. No wearer, person, head, face, eyes, glasses, mouth, lips, teeth, body, hand, clothing, or portrait. No red, crimson, orange, flame, blood drop, liquid, blood, strand, ribbon, or mouth-emitted magic. No text, letter, number, equation, formula, mathematical notation, pseudo-glyph, rune-like writing, logo, signature, or watermark. No sword, blade, dagger, staff, wand, rod, spear, shield, helmet, weapon, held prop, pedestal, backing plate, decorative frame, scenery, second object, duplicate, panel, or sprite sheet. Do not crop the crown. Do not simply recolor a full-color crown; this must be a purpose-built solid white and pale-blue line-art asset.
